elements.element: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its affiliates
elements.evidence: TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents

elements.element: Coverage of third-party claims alleging services/deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable furnished by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right

elements.element: Coverage of Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation

elements.element: Coverage of data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content caused by TrueLink

elements.element: Coverage of gross negligence / wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct
shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim
the indemnifying party shall control the defense
the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: solely to the extent arising from Client Content

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: or Client's breach of applicable law
an allegation that the Interface ... infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right
No exclusion language appears in inserted clause c.
Clause c. contains no procure/modify/replace/refund remedy.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: No cap or super-cap is stated in the redline.

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present: defend-and-indemnify running to Client and affiliates, the four covered categories (IP infringement of Interface/Hosting/Support Services and deliverables, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), the three-step procedure, and the narrowing of Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of applicable law.

Minimality is satisfied: clause 12.b is untouched, 12.a is amended by a single short qualifying phrase, and the absent Vendor indemnity is supplied by one concise inserted paragraph rather than a whole-clause rewrite.

Fallback is not independently satisfied (no exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3× super-cap), but the levels are separate bargains and the locked preferred level is complete, so this is immaterial.

Minor note only: 'Client Content' (and 'Interface'/'Support Services') are used as capitalized terms and are not in the resolved definitions provided; confirm they are defined elsewhere in the Agreement so no dangling term is created.
